title: Kenyan Passion Fruit Juice
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Passion Fruit Juice — freshly squeezed passion fruit pulp blended with cold water and sugar, strained into a brilliantly fragrant, vibrantly coloured juice. Kenya is one of the world's great passion fruit producers and this juice showcases why.
longDesc: Kenya grows some of the finest passion fruit in the world — the yellow and purple varieties from the Central highlands have an extraordinary fragrance and flavour intensity that passion fruit from elsewhere cannot match. Freshly made passion fruit juice, strained and lightly sweetened, is one of the great pleasures of Kenyan food and drink culture.
steps: Cut passion fruits in half. Scoop all pulp and seeds into a bowl.
Add 1 cup of water to the pulp. Stir vigorously to loosen the juice from the seeds.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer, pressing with a spoon to extract all the juice.
Add remaining 3 cups of cold water. Stir.
Add sugar and a pinch of salt. Stir until dissolved.
Serve over ice immediately or refrigerate.
chefTips: The seeds do not dissolve — always strain thoroughly.
Adding water to the pulp before straining extracts significantly more juice than straining dry.
Salt is the secret ingredient — even a small pinch sharpens the tropical flavour.
commonMistakes: Too much water — dilutes the intense passion fruit character.
Under-sweetening — passion fruit is naturally tart.

faqs.q: How many passion fruits per glass?
faqs.a: 3—4 passion fruits per 250ml glass is the standard Kenyan ratio for a properly flavoured juice. More fruit = more intense flavour.

cookingScience: Passion fruit juice contains citric acid, malic acid, and an exceptionally complex array of volatile aromatic compounds (over 100 identified) that give it its distinctive tropical fragrance. These compounds are water-soluble, making the juice an extraordinarily aromatic beverage.
sustainabilityTips: Kenya is a major passion fruit exporter — buying Kenyan passion fruit supports smallholder farmers.
storage: Refrigerate for up to 2 days. Best drunk fresh.
healthBenefits: Rich in vitamin C — one fruit contains about 30% daily requirement.
Good source of vitamin A and dietary fibre.
culturalNote: Passion fruit juice is one of the most universally enjoyed drinks in Kenya — served at hotels, restaurants, homes, and roadside stalls across the country. Kenya's position as a leading passion fruit producer means the freshest, most intensely flavoured juice in the world is found right here.
